messages:
Anya: quick heads-up: after yesterday's console rollout we saw a small cohort with duplicate resume charges for SSE streams.
Greg: saw the spike in billing logs. reconnect/backoff looks normal; meter shows 2 increments for what should be a single resume.
Shreya: any repro? could it be resume-id being dropped somewhere so idempotency fails?
Anya: minimal repro I used: open SSE -> kill connection -> client posts resume within 2-4s. Server accepts with 204 but billing shows 2 increments. snippet from logs: 
Anya: ```
Client -> POST /v1/streams/resume
  X-Resume-ID: resume-abc-42
Proxy -> retry path rebuilt request, omitted X-Resume-ID header
Server -> 204 resume accepted
Billing -> increment tokens (twice)
```
Greg: oh. proxy retry code intentionally rebuilds req for idempotent attempts and we forgot to include the resume header.
ConsoleUI: FYI console telemetry sampling was reduced to 5% last week; metering is unsampled so sampling mismatch can hide duplicates in traces.
Shreya: so two issues: (1) header propagation in proxy, (2) telemetry vs metering correlation. We should emit a resume_fingerprint on meter events so sampled traces can be correlated to billing.
Greg: short-term fix: change proxy retry code to preserve X-Resume-ID and any resume-related headers. I'll open a small PR for that.
Anya: short-term mitigation: server-side dedupe: if a resume_fingerprint was seen within a 20s window, don't increment charge. safer to avoid spikes.
Shreya: long-term: add a config flag on meter pipeline "resume_dedupe_window" default 15s, and attach fingerprint to events. Also add a feature flag to opt-in.
Greg: deployment plan: patch proxy -> canary 10% -> monitor resume_charge vs unique_resume_fp. If clean, ramp to 100%.
DeployBot: canary 10% -> paused (errors +2) per policy; rolling back to previous canary until fixes land.
Anya: I'll create a dashboard card "resume_charges / unique_resume_fps" and alert if ratio > 1.02 for 10m. Also add a debug overlay in console to surface resume-id for a session.
Shreya: I'll prepare a short doc with API changes for billing events and specify the dedupe algorithm + migration. Add tests: e2e that kills connection and asserts single billing increment.
Greg: pinging @eng-infra for release window and @eng-sre for alert thresholds.
ConsoleUI: small UX note: when debugging streaming issues show last-resume-id and number of attempts in the drawer.
Anya: TL;DR: proxy header fix + server-side dedupe + attach resume fingerprint to metering/events + dashboard/alert. Assigning: Greg -> proxy, Shreya -> meter + docs, Anya -> dashboard. Follow-ups within 24h. :thumbsup:
